Overview
This listing features a glass-transition noodle dryer engineered for exceptional performance and reliability. With a substantial drying chamber volume of 3,800 litres, it is designed to accommodate large-scale operations with ease.

Performance Specifications
Operating at an air temperature of 29°C, this dryer efficiently removes up to 38 kilograms of moisture per day. The batch drying process is completed within 30 hours, ensuring consistent and thorough results for each cycle.

Design and Operation
